keyword.zh: 拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵输送距离怎么读

title.en: Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump: 40–100 m beside the Skid-steer loader article
title.zh: 拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印：对照「Skid-steer loader」时，40–100 m仍在原页

description.en: Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump. 40–100 m stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Skid-steer loader.
description.zh: 拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印。40–100 m仍在目录格子里。插图来自「Skid-steer loader」。

h1.en: Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump: 40–100 m beside the Skid-steer loader article
h1.zh: 拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印：对照「Skid-steer loader」时，40–100 m仍在原页

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump distance text in Xingtai as follows: Conveying Distance (H / V) is 40–100 m / 15–45 m. Read each label with its own figure. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Skid-steer_loader.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的距离文字写成：输送距离（水平/垂直）是40–100 m / 15–45 m。同一页如果同时有水平和垂直，两者不能对调；没有写出的垂直格也不能用别的型号去填。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Skid-steer_loader。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Skid-steer_loader. The picture shows Skid-steer loader. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump distance text in Xingtai as follows: Conveying Distance (H / V) is 40–100 m / 15–45 m. Conveying Distance (H / V) is 40–100 m / 15–45 m. Maximum aggregate size is 1–3 cm. If a distance entry is missing on the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump sheet, it stays missing.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Skid-steer_loader。画面是Skid-steer loader。河北品锦机械在邢台把拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的距离文字写成：输送距离（水平/垂直）是40–100 m / 15–45 m。管路沿程要克服摩擦，水平段和垂直升高不是同一项工作。

body.en: Read each label with its own figure. A pipeline loses pressure to friction, so a horizontal run and a vertical rise are different duties. Total Weight 1300 kg. Theoretical Output is 6–12 m³/h and Pumping Pressure is 15 MPa.
body.zh: 同一页如果同时有水平和垂直，两者不能对调；没有写出的垂直格也不能用别的型号去填。拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵这一页如果少了某一距离格，就让它继续空着。

body.en: Horizontal and vertical are not interchangeable when both appear, and a missing vertical entry is not filled from another model. The sheet already separates them when it lists both. Subject: Universalmotor 3. Neither entry is a metre.
body.zh: 画面「Electric motor」的主体是Universal电机 3，不能代替这些格子。理论输送量是6–12 m³/h，泵送压力是15 MPa。

body.en: The frame “Electric motor” shows Universalmotor 3 and does not replace these entries. Hopper capacity is 0.25 m³. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not read a metre figure off that frame. Do not paste another manufacturer's boom length onto Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump.
body.zh: 输送距离（水平/垂直）是40–100 m / 15–45 m。

question.en: Which distance text does Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump list?
question.zh: 拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵标出了哪几句距离？

answer.en: Conveying Distance (H / V) is 40–100 m / 15–45 m. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Skid-steer_loader.
answer.zh: 输送距离（水平/垂直）是40–100 m / 15–45 m。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Skid-steer_loader画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can horizontal and vertical be swapped?
question.zh: 水平和垂直可以对调吗？

answer.en: Only when the label itself puts them in that order. Keep the shown order. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Skid-steer_loader.
answer.zh: 只有标题本身写成那个顺序时才按那个顺序。保留写出来的次序。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Skid-steer_loader画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 6–12 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Skid-steer_loader.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是6–12 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Skid-steer_loader画面里印出的数字。
